title: Cadence table core: states, links and audit columns
goal: A "Cadence and evidence" section in the solution dashboard whose rows are projects and whose cells carry last run, next due and a state, with audits (column 1) as the first group
acceptance: One shared cell model: last, next, state (current / due / overdue / never run / unknown) and an evidence link; never run and overdue are flagged, missing evidence is unknown, never shown as fine
Column 1: full and scoped audit last and next, audit.enforce on or off, read through the F-104-T03 cadence code, not a second reader (extend, do not duplicate)
node tools/solution.mjs check --json carries the same cells
Fixture tests in tools/test-profiles.mjs, committed failing first: current, due, overdue, never run, unreadable evidence, future-dated evidence; a solution with no manifests is unchanged elsewhere
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories, manifests and API responses; no personal data, no real alert content.
escalation: A change to how an existing table, gap kind or evidence file behaves goes back to the owner
A source that cannot be read without a new token scope or a project edit is reported unknown, never worked around

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one cell model and renderer over data projectHealth already reads, plus fixtures. Not a measurement.
